localization/english/1776_imperial_const:
﻿l_english:
 aor1776_hre_request_effect_tt:0 "Demand the return of the selected registered imperial provinces. A member must obey unless the Emperor owes it an obligation. An external holder may refuse; the first refusal for that country and region causes 5 infamy and grants an imperial restitution casus belli for ten years. Normal truces still apply."
 aor1776_hre_return_effect_tt:0 "Return only the registered provinces wrongfully held in this state to their surviving imperial holders. No territory is annexed by the Emperor unless it was already registered as belonging to his country."
 aor1776_hre_refusal_effect_tt:0 "An imperial member protected by an obligation may refuse without infamy or a restitution casus belli. An external holder incurs 5 infamy on its first refusal for this region within ten years and grants the Emperor the restitution casus belli."
 identity_aor1776_imperial_federation:0 "Holy Roman Empire"
 identity_aor1776_imperial_federation_desc:0 "An elective imperial constitution: a common market, autonomous estates and a locked imperial bond without tribute."
 aor1776_imperial_obligation:0 "$concept_aor1776_hre_protectorate$"
 aor1776_imperial_obligation_desc:0 "$concept_aor1776_hre_protectorate_desc$"
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution:0 "Demand imperial restitution"
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution_desc:0 "Return the selected territory to its registered 1776 imperial holders. Imperial members must comply unless the Emperor owes them an obligation. An external refusal costs 5 infamy and authorises a restitution play for ten years, respecting normal truces. The penalty cannot be repeated against the same country for the same region during that period."
 aor1776_hre_restitution:0 "Imperial restitution"
 dp_aor1776_hre_restitution:0 "Imperial restitution"
 aor1776_hre_secession:0 "Secession from the Empire"

 aor1776_hre.20.t:0 "The imperial demand"
 aor1776_hre.20.d:0 "The Emperor demands that the provinces of [SCOPE.sState('hre_request_state').GetName] be restored to their registered imperial holders. Compliance restores the recognised boundaries; it does not enrich the imperial domain."
 aor1776_hre.20.a:0 "We shall restore what is rightfully theirs."
 aor1776_hre.20.b:0 "We will not yield these lands."

 aor1776_hre_member_tt:0 "Belongs to the recognised imperial estates and has not seceded."
 aor1776_hre_emperor_tt:0 "Holds the imperial crown."
 aor1776_hre_elector_tt:0 "Holds one of the nine recognised electoral titles, still has territory, and retains a monarchy or ecclesiastical government."
 aor1776_hre_candidate_tt:0 "An independent imperial monarchy with a living adult male ruler or heir."
 aor1776_hre_ballot_candidate_tt:0 "Eligible for the current imperial ballot."

 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release:0 "Demand the release of imperial estates"
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_desc:0 "Demand that this external power release its recognised imperial subjects and restore their wrongly held registered imperial provinces."
 aor1776_hre_release_request_tt:0 "All recognised imperial estates subject to this external power are covered, including indirect subjects. Other subjects are excluded. Refusal grants the Emperor a ten-year liberation casus belli; normal truces apply."
 aor1776_hre_release_effect_tt:0 "Release the recognised imperial subjects as independent countries, restore only their wrongly held registered provinces to surviving rightful holders, and reattach them to the imperial bond and bloc. The Emperor does not become their overlord."
 aor1776_hre_release_refusal_tt:0 "The first refusal within ten years costs 5 infamy. The Emperor receives a ten-year casus belli to release the imperial estates; all recognised imperial members are called to his side."
 aor1776_hre_subject_release:0 "Liberation of imperial estates"
 dp_aor1776_hre_subject_release:0 "Imperial liberation"
 aor1776_hre.21.t:0 "The Emperor claims his estates"
 aor1776_hre.21.d:0 "An imperial envoy demands the release of the estates of the Empire held beneath our crown. Their registered territorial rights must also be restored. The Emperor invokes the liberty of the estates, not their submission to his own country."
 aor1776_hre.21.a:0 "We shall release these estates and honour their rights."
 aor1776_hre.21.b:0 "We will not surrender our authority."
 aor1776_hre_bloc_departure_requires_secession_tt:0 "Imperial members must use [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$dp_aor1776_hre_secession$')] to leave the Empire."
 aor1776_hre_secession_in_imperial_bloc_tt:0 "Belongs to the imperial estates and is currently a member of the imperial [concept_power_bloc]."
localization/french/1776_imperial_consti:
﻿l_french:
 aor1776_hre_request_effect_tt:0 "Demander la restitution des provinces impériales enregistrées et sélectionnées. Un membre doit obéir, sauf si l’empereur lui doit une obligation. Un détenteur extérieur peut refuser : le premier refus pour ce pays et cette région entraîne 5 points d’infamie et un casus belli de rétrocession impériale valable dix ans. Les trêves ordinaires restent applicables."
 aor1776_hre_return_effect_tt:0 "Rendre uniquement les provinces détenues indûment dans cet État à leurs titulaires impériaux encore existants. L’empereur n’annexe aucun territoire, sauf celui déjà enregistré comme appartenant à son pays."
 aor1776_hre_refusal_effect_tt:0 "Un membre impérial protégé par une obligation peut refuser sans infamie ni casus belli de rétrocession. Un détenteur extérieur reçoit 5 points d’infamie lors de son premier refus pour cette région sur dix ans et ouvre le casus belli de rétrocession à l’empereur."
 identity_aor1776_imperial_federation:0 "Saint-Empire romain germanique"
 identity_aor1776_imperial_federation_desc:0 "Une constitution impériale élective : marché commun, États autonomes et lien impérial verrouillé sans tribut."
 aor1776_imperial_obligation:0 "$concept_aor1776_hre_protectorate$"
 aor1776_imperial_obligation_desc:0 "$concept_aor1776_hre_protectorate_desc$"
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution:0 "Exiger une rétrocession impériale"
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution_desc:0 "Restitue le territoire sélectionné à ses titulaires impériaux enregistrés en 1776. Les membres doivent accepter, sauf si l’empereur leur doit une obligation. Un refus extérieur coûte 5 points d’infamie et autorise une manœuvre de rétrocession pendant dix ans, dans le respect des trêves normales. La sanction ne peut être répétée contre le même pays pour la même région pendant cette période."
 aor1776_hre_restitution:0 "Rétrocession impériale"
 dp_aor1776_hre_restitution:0 "Rétrocession impériale"
 aor1776_hre_secession:0 "Sécession de l’Empire"
 dp_aor1776_hre_secession:0 "Sécession impériale"
 aor1776_hre.1.t:0 "Le trône vacant"
 aor1776_hre.20.t:0 "La sommation impériale"
 aor1776_hre.20.d:0 "L’empereur exige que les provinces de [SCOPE.sState('hre_request_state').GetName] soient rendues à leurs titulaires impériaux reconnus. Obtempérer rétablit leurs frontières ; cela n’enrichit pas le domaine impérial."
 aor1776_hre.20.a:0 "Nous restituerons ce qui leur revient de droit."
 aor1776_hre.20.b:0 "Nous ne céderons pas ces terres."

 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release:0 "Exiger la libération des États impériaux"
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_desc:0 "Exiger de cette puissance extérieure la libération de ses sujets impériaux reconnus et la restitution de leurs provinces impériales enregistrées détenues indûment."
 aor1776_hre_release_request_tt:0 "La demande couvre tous les États impériaux reconnus soumis à cette puissance extérieure, y compris indirectement. Les autres sujets sont exclus. Un refus ouvre un casus belli de libération valable dix ans ; les trêves normales restent applicables."
 aor1776_hre_release_effect_tt:0 "Libérer les sujets impériaux reconnus comme pays indépendants, rendre leurs seules provinces enregistrées détenues indûment aux titulaires légitimes encore existants et rétablir leur lien et leur bloc impériaux. L’empereur ne devient pas leur suzerain."
 aor1776_hre_release_refusal_tt:0 "Le premier refus sur dix ans coûte 5 points d’infamie. L’empereur reçoit un casus belli valable dix ans pour libérer les États impériaux ; tous les membres impériaux reconnus sont appelés à le soutenir."
 aor1776_hre_subject_release:0 "Libération des États impériaux"
 dp_aor1776_hre_subject_release:0 "Libération impériale"
 aor1776_hre.21.t:0 "L’empereur réclame ses États"
 aor1776_hre.21.d:0 "Un envoyé impérial exige la libération des États de l’Empire placés sous notre couronne. Leurs droits territoriaux enregistrés doivent également être rétablis. L’empereur invoque la liberté des États, non leur soumission à son propre pays."
 aor1776_hre.21.a:0 "Nous libérerons ces États et respecterons leurs droits."
 aor1776_hre.21.b:0 "Nous ne renoncerons pas à notre autorité."
 aor1776_hre_bloc_departure_requires_secession_tt:0 "Les membres impériaux doivent recourir au [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$dp_aor1776_hre_secession$')] pour quitter l’Empire."
 aor1776_hre_secession_in_imperial_bloc_tt:0 "Appartient aux États impériaux et fait actuellement partie du [concept_power_bloc|l] impérial."

 je_aor1776_hre_centralization:0 "The reform of the Empire"
 je_aor1776_hre_centralization_reason:0 "The Diet considers closer obligations between the Emperor and the estates. Their privileges remain guaranteed, and the imperial dignity remains elective."
 je_aor1776_hre_centralization_status:0 "A resolution of the Diet must precede any centralization."
 aor1776_hre.60.t:0 "The Empire considers its future"
 aor1776_hre.60.d:0 "The Diet, circles, courts and offices have acquired a common foundation. A closer constitution is possible, but the estates have not yet surrendered their autonomy."
 aor1776_hre.60.a:0 "We shall preserve the Empire through its renewal."
 aor1776_hre.61.t:0 "The protection of the imperial crown"
 aor1776_hre.61.d:0 "The imperial estates now stand under the protection of the Emperor as autonomous subjects, without tribute. Their rulers remain in office."
 aor1776_hre.61.a:0 "We shall preserve the Empire through its renewal."
 aor1776_hre.62.t:0 "The estates beneath one crown"
 aor1776_hre.62.d:0 "The estates remain distinct, but foreign policy and military obligations are now subordinate to the imperial crown."

 aor1776_hre.63.t:0 "One imperial state"
 aor1776_hre.63.d:0 "The remaining imperial crown lands have been united under one government. Their people and lands now belong to the unified imperial state."
 aor1776_hre.63.a:0 "We shall preserve the Empire through its renewal."

 dp_aor1776_hre_subject_release_tooltip:0 "Select an imperial subject of the refusing external power. Each targeted subject receives its own primary liberation goal. Occupy the targeted estates, not the foreign capital."
 aor1776_hre_enforce_internal_restitution:0 "Enforce imperial restitution"
 aor1776_hre_enforce_internal_restitution_desc:0 "An imperial estate must immediately restore the listed registered provinces. It cannot refuse unless the Emperor owes it an obligation; that case uses the approval-based request instead."
 aor1776_hre_reply_infamy:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_new_infamy_holder').GetName] received 5 infamy for this first refusal. The imperial casus belli lasts ten years; existing truces remain binding."

 aor1776_hre.35.t:0 "An imperial estate regains its liberty"
 aor1776_hre.1.f:0 "#italic “He left nine places for the seals, and a tenth for the silence of the dead Emperor. No envoy wished to speak first.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.20.f:0 "#italic “The border had moved on the map, but not in the old register. The envoy set both upon the table and waited.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.21.f:0 "#italic “Beneath the foreign seal lay three smaller impressions. The clerk traced each one with a finger, as if freeing a name from its wax.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.30.f:0 "#italic “At dawn, the city gates opened without a shot. The messenger read the decree twice; the second time, the crowd answered.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.30.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] has released the imperial estates listed in our council’s settlement. Their liberty and registered territorial rights have been restored."
 aor1776_hre.30.result:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] has released the imperial estates listed in our council’s settlement. Their liberty and registered territorial rights have been restored.\nThe following list records this settlement, not a new action:"
 aor1776_hre.31.f:0 "#italic “The letter returned with its seal unbroken. In the council chamber, the rustle of paper sounded louder than an insult.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.32.f:0 "#italic “The surveyor rubbed out the latest line. Beneath it, faint but stubborn, the older boundary remained.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.32.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] has restored the registered provinces to their lawful imperial holders. The settlement’s exact territories appear below."
 aor1776_hre.32.result:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] has restored the registered provinces to their lawful imperial holders. The settlement’s exact territories appear below.\nThe following list records this settlement, not a new action:"
 aor1776_hre.33.f:0 "#italic “The envoy folded the rejected summons. Outside, a groom held his horse; inside, no one offered him a chair.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.33.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] has rejected the territorial summons. An external holder’s refusal authorises restitution proceedings; a protected imperial member retains the right to refuse."
 aor1776_hre.34.f:0 "#italic “When the final seal cooled, the clerk carried the register back to its shelf. For once, the ink and the border agreed.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.34.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] has submitted to the imperial settlement. The subjects and registered territories concerned are recorded below."
 aor1776_hre.34.result:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] has submitted to the imperial settlement. The subjects and registered territories concerned are recorded below.\nThe following list records this settlement, not a new action:"
 aor1776_hre.35.f:0 "#italic “The old banner rose slowly over the square. No one cheered until its shadow reached the courthouse steps.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.35.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_freed_estate').GetName] is released from foreign overlordship. The settlement restores its imperial standing and returns only those registered provinces it held contrary to other estates’ rights."
 aor1776_hre.35.result:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_freed_estate').GetName] is released from foreign overlordship. The settlement restores its imperial standing and returns only those registered provinces it held contrary to other estates’ rights.\nThe following list records this settlement, not a new action:"
 aor1776_hre.41.f:0 "#italic “They removed the empty chair from the wall and brought it back to the council table. Its owner had never ceased to claim his place.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.60.f:0 "#italic “Each envoy brought a different map. By nightfall, they had begun to argue over a single page.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.61.f:0 "#italic “The prince kept his keys, his court and his guards. Only the oath at the bottom of the parchment had changed.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.62.f:0 "#italic “Orders now arrived beneath the same eagle. The old seals remained, but the clerk no longer asked which road the letter should take.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."
 aor1776_hre.63.f:0 "#italic “The shelves still bore the names of the former courts. One register lay open upon the desk; for the first time, it named them all.”#! — The Letters of the Imperial Clerk (imaginary novel)."

 aor1776_hre.35.t:0 "Un État impérial retrouve sa liberté"
 aor1776_hre.1.f:0 "#italic « Il réserva neuf places aux sceaux, et une dixième au silence de l’empereur mort. Aucun envoyé ne voulait parler le premier. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.20.f:0 "#italic « La frontière avait bougé sur la carte, mais non dans le vieux registre. L’envoyé posa les deux sur la table et attendit. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.21.f:0 "#italic « Sous le sceau étranger reposaient trois empreintes plus petites. Le clerc les suivit du doigt, comme pour libérer un nom de sa cire. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.30.f:0 "#italic « À l’aube, les portes de la ville s’ouvrirent sans un coup de feu. Le messager lut deux fois le décret ; à la seconde, la foule répondit. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.30.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] a libéré les États impériaux désignés par notre conseil. Leur liberté et leurs droits territoriaux enregistrés ont été rétablis."
 aor1776_hre.30.result:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] a libéré les États impériaux désignés par notre conseil. Leur liberté et leurs droits territoriaux enregistrés ont été rétablis.\nLa liste suivante décrit ce règlement, pas une nouvelle action :"
 aor1776_hre.31.f:0 "#italic « La lettre revint, son sceau intact. Dans la salle du conseil, le froissement du papier retentit plus fort qu’une insulte. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.32.f:0 "#italic « L’arpenteur effaça le trait le plus récent. Dessous, pâle mais obstinée, demeurait l’ancienne frontière. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.32.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] a restitué les provinces enregistrées à leurs titulaires impériaux légitimes. Les territoires précis du règlement sont indiqués ci-dessous."
 aor1776_hre.32.result:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] a restitué les provinces enregistrées à leurs titulaires impériaux légitimes. Les territoires précis du règlement sont indiqués ci-dessous.\nLa liste suivante décrit ce règlement, pas une nouvelle action :"
 aor1776_hre.33.f:0 "#italic « L’envoyé replia la sommation rejetée. Dehors, un palefrenier retenait son cheval ; dedans, personne ne lui offrit de chaise. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.33.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] a rejeté la sommation territoriale. Le refus d’un détenteur extérieur ouvre la voie à une rétrocession ; un membre impérial protégé conserve son droit de refus."
 aor1776_hre.34.f:0 "#italic « Lorsque le dernier sceau eut refroidi, le clerc remit le registre sur son étagère. Pour une fois, l’encre et la frontière s’accordaient. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.34.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] s’est soumis au règlement impérial. Les sujets et territoires enregistrés concernés sont consignés ci-dessous."
 aor1776_hre.34.result:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] s’est soumis au règlement impérial. Les sujets et territoires enregistrés concernés sont consignés ci-dessous.\nLa liste suivante décrit ce règlement, pas une nouvelle action :"
 aor1776_hre.35.f:0 "#italic « La vieille bannière s’éleva lentement au-dessus de la place. Nul n’acclama avant que son ombre atteignît les marches du tribunal. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.35.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_freed_estate').GetName] est libéré de la suzeraineté étrangère. Le règlement rétablit sa place dans l’Empire et ne restitue que les provinces enregistrées détenues en violation des droits d’autres États."
 aor1776_hre.35.result:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_freed_estate').GetName] est libéré de la suzeraineté étrangère. Le règlement rétablit sa place dans l’Empire et ne restitue que les provinces enregistrées détenues en violation des droits d’autres États.\nLa liste suivante décrit ce règlement, pas une nouvelle action :"
 aor1776_hre.41.f:0 "#italic « On retira la chaise vide du mur pour la remettre à la table du conseil. Son propriétaire n’avait jamais cessé de réclamer sa place. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.60.f:0 "#italic « Chaque envoyé avait apporté une carte différente. À la nuit tombée, ils avaient commencé à débattre d’une seule page. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.61.f:0 "#italic « Le prince conserva ses clefs, sa cour et ses gardes. Seul le serment au bas du parchemin avait changé. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.62.f:0 "#italic « Les ordres arrivaient désormais sous le même aigle. Les vieux sceaux demeuraient, mais le clerc ne demandait plus quel chemin devait prendre la lettre. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."
 aor1776_hre.63.f:0 "#italic « Les étagères portaient encore les noms des anciennes cours. Un registre ouvert reposait sur le bureau ; pour la première fois, il les nommait toutes. »#! — Les lettres du greffier impérial (roman imaginaire)."

﻿l_english:
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_notification_name:0 "Imperial summons — imperial liberation"
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_notification_desc:0 "[INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName] demands the release of our imperial subjects listed below and the restoration of their registered territorial rights. This diplomatic request covers the listed estates collectively. A separately launched liberation play targets one selected estate; further war goals must be added deliberately."
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_third_party_accepted_name:0 "Imperial demand — accepted"
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_third_party_accepted_desc:0 "[TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] has accepted the imperial demand from [INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName]."
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_third_party_declined_name:0 "Imperial demand — refused"
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_third_party_declined_desc:0 "[TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] has refused the imperial demand from [INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName]."
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_declined_name:0 "Imperial liberation — Refused"
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_declined_desc:0 "[TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] has refused to release the imperial estates. Use Imperial Liberation and select the subject to free, not the foreign overlord’s homeland. Imperial Restitution is available only for registered imperial provinces actually held by that power. Existing truces and normal diplomatic restrictions remain binding."
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_accepted_name:0 "Imperial liberation — Accepted"
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_accepted_desc:0 "[TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] has accepted our demand. The council’s settlement notice records the subjects or provinces concerned."
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution_proposal_notification_name:0 "Imperial summons — imperial restitution"
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution_proposal_notification_desc:0 "[INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName] demands that the imperial provinces listed below be restored to their registered legitimate holders. Review the territories and the consequences of accepting or refusing before answering."
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution_proposal_third_party_accepted_name:0 "Imperial demand — accepted"
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution_proposal_third_party_accepted_desc:0 "[TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] has accepted the imperial demand from [INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName]."
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution_proposal_third_party_declined_name:0 "Imperial demand — refused"
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution_proposal_third_party_declined_desc:0 "[TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] has refused the imperial demand from [INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName]."
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution_proposal_declined_name:0 "Imperial restitution — Refused"
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution_proposal_declined_desc:0 "[TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] has refused the territorial summons. Use Imperial Restitution on the disputed imperial state. An imperial member protected by an obligation may refuse without granting a casus belli. Existing truces remain binding."
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution_proposal_accepted_name:0 "Imperial restitution — Accepted"
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution_proposal_accepted_desc:0 "[TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] has accepted our demand. The council’s settlement notice records the subjects or provinces concerned."
 aor1776_hre_enforce_internal_restitution_proposal_notification_name:0 "Imperial summons — imperial restitution"
 aor1776_hre_enforce_internal_restitution_proposal_notification_desc:0 "[INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName] demands that the imperial provinces listed below be restored to their registered legitimate holders. Review the territories and the consequences of accepting or refusing before answering."

 aor1776_hre_enforce_internal_restitution_proposal_declined_desc:0 "[TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] has refused the territorial summons. Use Imperial Restitution on the disputed imperial state. An imperial member protected by an obligation may refuse without granting a casus belli. Existing truces remain binding."
 aor1776_hre_enforce_internal_restitution_proposal_accepted_name:0 "Imperial restitution — Accepted"
 aor1776_hre_enforce_internal_restitution_proposal_accepted_desc:0 "[TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] has accepted our demand. The council’s settlement notice records the subjects or provinces concerned."
 aor1776_hre_restitution_refusal_valid_tt:0 "The current foreign holder has refused the relevant imperial demand within the last ten years."
 dp_aor1776_hre_restitution_tooltip:0 "Restore wrongfully held registered imperial provinces. Select a disputed imperial state, not an arbitrary foreign province. To free an imperial subject, use Imperial Liberation and select that subject."
 aor1776_hre.31.result:0 "The imperial liberation casus belli is available for the listed subjects for ten years. Select the subject as the target. If the refusing power directly holds disputed imperial provinces, restitution is also available on those states. Normal truces are not bypassed."
 aor1776_hre.33.result:0 "An external holder’s refusal opens restitution on the listed imperial provinces for ten years; a member protected by an obligation may refuse without a casus belli. Select the disputed imperial state, and respect any existing truce."
 aor1776_hre.31.d:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('hre_reply_holder').GetName] has refused to release the imperial estates. The council may seek their liberation; the settlement list names each estate whose foreign dependency is disputed."
localization/french/1776_imperial_demand:
﻿l_french:
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_notification_name:0 "Sommation impériale — libération impériale"
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_notification_desc:0 "[INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName] exige la libération de nos sujets impériaux listés ci-dessous et le rétablissement de leurs droits territoriaux enregistrés. Cette demande diplomatique porte collectivement sur les États listés. Un coup diplomatique de libération lancé séparément vise un seul État sélectionné ; les autres objectifs doivent être ajoutés volontairement."
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_third_party_accepted_name:0 "Demande impériale — accepté"
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_third_party_accepted_desc:0 "[TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] a accepté la demande impériale de [INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName]."
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_third_party_declined_name:0 "Demande impériale — refusé"
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_third_party_declined_desc:0 "[TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] a refusé la demande impériale de [INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName]."
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_declined_name:0 "Libération impériale — Refusée"
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_declined_desc:0 "[TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] a refusé de libérer les États impériaux. Utilisez Libération impériale et sélectionnez le sujet à libérer, pas le territoire national du suzerain étranger. Rétrocession impériale ne vise que des provinces impériales enregistrées réellement détenues par cette puissance. Les trêves et restrictions diplomatiques normales restent applicables."
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_accepted_name:0 "Libération impériale — Acceptée"
 aor1776_hre_request_subject_release_proposal_accepted_desc:0 "[TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] a accepté notre demande. L’avis de règlement du conseil précise les sujets ou provinces concernés."
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution_proposal_notification_name:0 "Sommation impériale — rétrocession impériale"
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution_proposal_notification_desc:0 "[INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName] exige que les provinces impériales listées ci-dessous soient rendues à leurs titulaires légitimes enregistrés. Examinez les territoires et les conséquences d’un accord ou d’un refus avant de répondre."

 aor1776_hre_request_restitution_proposal_declined_name:0 "Rétrocession impériale — Refusée"
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution_proposal_declined_desc:0 "[TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] a refusé la sommation territoriale. Utilisez Rétrocession impériale sur l’État impérial disputé. Un membre protégé par une obligation peut refuser sans ouvrir de casus belli. Les trêves existantes restent applicables."
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution_proposal_accepted_name:0 "Rétrocession impériale — Acceptée"
 aor1776_hre_request_restitution_proposal_accepted_desc:0 "[TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] a accepté notre demande. L’avis de règlement du conseil précise les sujets ou provinces concernés."

 aor1776_hre_enforce_internal_restitution_proposal_notification_desc:0 "[INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName] exige que les provinces impériales listées ci-dessous soient rendues à leurs titulaires légitimes enregistrés.  aor1776_hre_enforce_internal_restitution_proposal_third_party_accepted_desc:0 "[TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] a accepté la demande impériale de [INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName]."
 aor1776_hre_enforce_internal_restitution_proposal_third_party_declined_name:0 "Demande impériale — refusé"

Un membre protégé par une obligation peut refuser sans ouvrir de casus belli. Les trêves existantes restent applicables."

 aor1776_hre_enforce_internal_restitution_proposal_accepted_desc:0 "[TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] a accepté notre demande. L’avis de règlement du conseil précise les sujets ou provinces concernés."
 aor1776_hre_restitution_refusal_valid_tt:0 "Le détenteur étranger actuel a refusé la demande impériale correspondante au cours des dix dernières années."
 dp_aor1776_hre_restitution_tooltip:0 "Restituer les provinces impériales enregistrées détenues indûment. Sélectionner un État impérial disputé, pas une province étrangère quelconque. Pour libérer un sujet impérial, utiliser Libération impériale et sélectionner ce sujet."
 aor1776_hre.31.result:0 "Le casus belli de libération impériale est ouvert pendant dix ans pour les sujets listés. Sélectionnez le sujet comme cible. Si la puissance ayant refusé détient directement des provinces impériales disputées, la rétrocession est aussi ouverte sur ces États. Les trêves ordinaires ne sont pas contournées."
 aor1776_hre.33.result:0 "Le refus d’un détenteur extérieur ouvre la rétrocession sur les provinces impériales listées pendant dix ans ; un membre protégé par une obligation peut refuser sans casus belli. Sélectionnez l’État impérial disputé et respectez toute trêve existante."

 aor1776_hre_no_direct_annexation_tt:0 "Imperial privileges forbid direct annexation."
 aor1776_hre_centralization_not_authorized_tt:0 "The Diet has not authorized this centralization."
 concept_aor1776_hre_protectorate_desc:0 "The princes and cities of the Empire retain their institutions while recognizing imperial authority. This [concept_subject_type] retains diplomatic autonomy and pays no compulsory weekly tribute. It is not automatically called into the Emperor’s [Concept('concept_war','$concept_wars$')|l]; military duties follow the Imperial Circles and imperial restitution rules. Strengthening the bond creates an [concept_imperial_estate], or an [concept_imperial_elector] when the country holds electoral privilege, without annexation. Leaving the Empire requires a successful secession [concept_diplomatic_play]."
 concept_imperial_estate_desc:0 "An imperial estate retains its ruler and [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')|l] under strengthened imperial authority. This [concept_subject_type] cannot launch its own [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')|l] and must join its [concept_overlord]’s [Concept('concept_war','$concept_wars$')|l]. It pays #v 15%#! of its [concept_treasury] revenue each week. Its [concept_liberty_desire] can lead it to seek independence. Ordinary annexation is barred by imperial privileges, and the imperial dignity remains elective. Increasing its [concept_autonomy] restores an [concept_aor1776_hre_protectorate], not independence."
 concept_imperial_elector_desc:0 "An imperial elector retains a voice in the election of the Emperor, together with its ruler and [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')|l]. This [concept_subject_type] cannot launch its own [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')|l] and must join its [concept_overlord]’s [Concept('concept_war','$concept_wars$')|l]. It pays #v 10%#! of its [concept_treasury] revenue each week. Its [concept_liberty_desire] remains active. Electoral privilege bars ordinary annexation by the overlord; the imperial dignity does not become hereditary. Increasing its [concept_autonomy] restores an [concept_aor1776_hre_protectorate], not independence."

﻿l_french:
 concept_aor1776_hre_protectorate:0 "Lien impérial"
 concept_imperial_estate:0 "État impérial"
 concept_imperial_elector:0 "Électorat impérial"
 aor1776_hre_no_direct_annexation_tt:0 "Les privilèges impériaux interdisent l’annexion directe."
 aor1776_hre_centralization_not_authorized_tt:0 "La Diète n’a pas autorisé cette centralisation."
 concept_aor1776_hre_protectorate_desc:0 "Les princes et villes de l’Empire conservent leurs institutions tout en reconnaissant l’autorité impériale. Ce [concept_subject_type|l] conserve son autonomie diplomatique et ne verse aucun tribut hebdomadaire obligatoire. Il n’est pas automatiquement appelé dans les [Concept('concept_war','$concept_wars$')|l] de l’empereur : ses obligations militaires suivent les Cercles impériaux et les règles de rétrocession impériale. Renforcer ce lien le transforme en [concept_imperial_estate], ou en [concept_imperial_elector] s’il possède la dignité électorale, sans annexion. Quitter l’Empire exige un [concept_diplomatic_play|l] de sécession victorieux."
 concept_imperial_estate_desc:0 "Un État impérial conserve son dirigeant et ses [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')|l] sous une autorité impériale renforcée. Ce [concept_subject_type|l] ne peut pas jouer ses propres [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')|l] et doit rejoindre les [Concept('concept_war','$concept_wars$')|l] de son [concept_overlord|l]. Il verse chaque semaine #v 15 %#! des revenus de son [concept_treasury]. Son [concept_liberty_desire|l] peut le conduire à réclamer l’indépendance. Les privilèges impériaux excluent l’annexion ordinaire et la dignité impériale demeure élective. Une augmentation de son [concept_autonomy|l] le transforme en [concept_aor1776_hre_protectorate], sans lui accorder l’indépendance."
 concept_imperial_elector_desc:0 "Un électorat impérial conserve une voix dans l’élection de l’empereur, ainsi que son dirigeant et ses [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')|l]. Ce [concept_subject_type|l] ne peut pas jouer ses propres [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')|l] et doit rejoindre les [Concept('concept_war','$concept_wars$')|l] de son [concept_overlord|l]. Il verse chaque semaine #v 10 %#! des revenus de son [concept_treasury]. Son [concept_liberty_desire|l] reste actif. Son privilège électoral interdit l’annexion ordinaire par le suzerain ; la dignité impériale ne devient pas héréditaire. Une augmentation de son [concept_autonomy|l] le transforme en [concept_aor1776_hre_protectorate], sans lui accorder l’indépendance."

localization/english/replace/1776_imperi:
﻿l_english:
 aor1776_hre_autonomy_reduction_allowed_tt:0 "Only the Emperor can strengthen an eligible Imperial Bond, outside an imperial election. Imperial Estates and Electorates cannot be annexed by lowering autonomy."
 aor1776_hre_link_lower_tooltip:0 "#header Imperial centralization#!\nLowering the [concept_autonomy] of an [concept_aor1776_hre_protectorate] makes it an [concept_imperial_estate], or an [concept_imperial_elector] if it holds electoral privilege. It is not annexed. Its territory, ruler and [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')|l] remain its own."
 aor1776_hre_estate_higher_tooltip:0 "#header Imperial Bond#!\nIncreasing the [concept_autonomy] of an [concept_imperial_estate] or [concept_imperial_elector] restores an [concept_aor1776_hre_protectorate]. It does not grant independence or remove electoral privilege."
 aor1776_hre_protected_terminal_tooltip:0 "#header Imperial privileges#!\nAn [concept_imperial_estate] or [concept_imperial_elector] cannot be annexed by further reducing its [concept_autonomy]."
 aor1776_vanilla_subject_type_annex_tooltip:0 "#header Annexation#!\nDecreasing the [concept_autonomy] of a [SubjectType.GetName] would lead to #b Annexation#!"
 aor1776_subject_type_annex_tooltip_nonlink:0 "[SelectLocalization(Or(EqualTo_string(SubjectType.GetKey, 'subject_type_imperial_estate'), EqualTo_string(SubjectType.GetKey, 'subject_type_imperial_elector')), 'aor1776_hre_protected_terminal_tooltip', 'aor1776_vanilla_subject_type_annex_tooltip')]"
 SUBJECT_TYPE_ANNEX_TOOLTIP:0 "[SelectLocalization(EqualTo_string(SubjectType.GetKey, 'subject_type_aor1776_hre_protectorate'), 'aor1776_hre_link_lower_tooltip', 'aor1776_subject_type_annex_tooltip_nonlink')]"
 aor1776_vanilla_subject_type_decreased_autonomy_tooltip:0 "#header [SubjectType.GetLowerAutonomySubjectType(GetPlayer.Self).GetName]#!\nDecreasing the [concept_autonomy] of a [SubjectType.GetName] would make that [concept_country] a [SubjectType.GetLowerAutonomySubjectType(GetPlayer.Self).GetName] instead"
 SUBJECT_TYPE_DECREASED_AUTONOMY_TOOLTIP:0 "[SelectLocalization(EqualTo_string(SubjectType.GetKey, 'subject_type_aor1776_hre_protectorate'), 'aor1776_hre_link_lower_tooltip', 'aor1776_vanilla_subject_type_decreased_autonomy_tooltip')]"
 aor1776_vanilla_subject_type_independence_tooltip:0 "#header Independence#!\nIncreasing the [concept_autonomy] of a [SubjectType.GetName] would lead to #b Independence#!"
 SUBJECT_TYPE_INDEPENDENCE_TOOLTIP:0 "[SelectLocalization(Or(EqualTo_string(SubjectType.GetKey, 'subject_type_imperial_estate'), EqualTo_string(SubjectType.GetKey, 'subject_type_imperial_elector')), 'aor1776_hre_estate_higher_tooltip', 'aor1776_vanilla_subject_type_independence_tooltip')]"

 SUBJECT_TYPE_INCREASED_AUTONOMY_TOOLTIP:0 "[SelectLocalization(Or(EqualTo_string(SubjectType.GetKey, 'subject_type_imperial_estate'), EqualTo_string(SubjectType.GetKey, 'subject_type_imperial_elector')), 'aor1776_hre_estate_higher_tooltip', 'aor1776_vanilla_subject_type_increased_autonomy_tooltip')]"
 aor1776_vanilla_subject_can_not_decrease_own_autonomy_annex_tooltip:0 "#header Decrease [concept_autonomy] to Annexation#!\n@red_cross! Can only be done by the [concept_overlord]"
 aor1776_subject_can_not_decrease_own_autonomy_annex_tooltip_nonlink:0 "[SelectLocalization(Or(EqualTo_string(SubjectType.GetKey, 'subject_type_imperial_estate'), EqualTo_string(SubjectType.GetKey, 'subject_type_imperial_elector')), 'aor1776_hre_protected_terminal_tooltip', 'aor1776_vanilla_subject_can_not_decrease_own_autonomy_annex_tooltip')]"
